summary: ChartFox charts in the EFB and on the map, an accurate landing rate, terminals and gates at airports, and new airport and aircraft icons.
releaseNotes: Connect your ChartFox account in Charts: its charts lead the chart list by type and open in the Stratos viewer.
Your route's georeferenced ChartFox SID, STAR and approach are laid on the map automatically; turn them off with the ChartFox chip in Layers.
Airport terminals now appear on the airport map.
Landing rate comes from the simulator's own touchdown and wheel contact, not the flare. Restart the bridge to use it.
SIDs and STARs are named by their procedure, e.g. SID - OSHNN5.
Many more traffic aircraft show their real shape instead of a generic plane.
Charts no longer shows the previous airport's country and publisher after switching airports.
Gates are visible on the airport map at normal zoom.
Airports are shown as pins, with major airports in purple.
A new Charts icon, and a tidier Charts layout.
